background: L3 runtime closure for TP-DMX-PR1304-RED-LANE-PATH-REGEX-HARDENING-002. Automated review on this packet's own prior test-only draft (PR #1325) found and this session independently reproduced a live bypass: RedLaneScanner silently failed to block exact-match FORBIDDEN_PATHS entries carrying a control character, because PR #1322's \Z re-anchoring correctly fixed the wildcard rules but regressed the exact-match rules on this consumer, which has no independent control-character layer the way the hook does. Adds an unconditional scanner-side short-circuit mirroring the hook's, plus a regression matrix covering exact-match, wildcard, exemption-spoof, arbitrary-malformed, and clean-control cases (wildcard cases ported from PR #1321, head 353bd8b245beb2c137f1ef94b45227d885328fed, fetched and hash-verified before extraction). Isolated anti-vacuity mutation confirms the fix is load-bearing. src/dopemux/dcp/red_lane_rules.py and .claude/hooks/dcp_surface_guard.py are untouched, per packet scope. This PR does not merge as part of this proof.
